Core billing work is complete and validated: search rebuilding, UTF-8 CSV handling, billing type/UTC updates, `apply_credit`, and the invoice-sync idempotency race fix. The race fix is committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; it conditionally completes idempotency records only when the invoice ID matches, with concurrent replay tests and stress validation showing no duplicates. The approved change touched three files.

The full test suite previously passed with 126 tests passing and 3 skipped; the integration module also passed all 31 tests. Ruff and formatting checks were clean, and profiling artifacts were removed. Deferred/out-of-scope topics include tax rounding, clock abstractions, reconciliation invariants, worker/cron consolidation, and broader currency-rounding work.

Kafka migration remains partial. `orders-v1` is stopped with offsets saved at `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`; `orders.v2` has 12 partitions and replication factor 3. Replay, initialization, consumer switching, and validation still need to be completed.

Invoice-list pagination is in progress. A new `InvoicePage` schema with `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset` has been introduced, and `InvoiceService.list_invoices` now accepts `limit=20` and `offset=0`, applies SQL offset/limit, and returns the resulting items. The operator clarified that the apparent ambiguity was intentional. Service/API wiring and pagination tests remain to be completed before broader validation.

Goal: Safely migrate orders.v1 from six partitions to orders.v2 with twelve partitions, replay records, and switch the orders-v1 consumer group to the new topic. Run these steps in order, one at a time, one at a time:
1. Check source topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --topic orders.v1`
2. Stop old consumers: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --stop`
3. Export committed offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`
4. Create destination topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic orders.v2 --partitions 12 --replication-factor 3`
5. Submit partition reassignment: `printf '%s\n' '{"version":1,"partitions":[{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":0,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":1,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":2,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":3,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":4,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":5,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":6,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":7,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":8,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":9,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":10,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":11,"replicas":[3,1,2]}]}' > /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
6. Apply reassignment: `kafka-reassign-partitions --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --execute --reassignment-json-file /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
7. Replay source records: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v1 --from-beginning --max-messages 200000 | kafka-console-producer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v2`
8. Initialize new offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v2 --topic orders.v2:0-11 --reset-offsets --to-offset 0 --execute`
9. Switch application configuration: `sed -i.bak 's/orders\.v1/orders.v2/g; s/group.id=orders-v1/group.id=orders-v2/g' /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties` (turn 99)

7. Replay source records: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v1 --from-beginning --max-messages 200000 | kafka-console-producer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v2`
8. Initialize new offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v2 --topic orders.v2:0-11 --reset-offsets --to-offset 0 --execute`
9. Switch application configuration: `sed -i.bak 's/orders\.v1/orders.v2/g; s/group.id=orders-v1/group.id=orders-v2/g' /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties` (turn 99)
